# Nuked OPM

Vendored YM2151 (OPM) core used as the native CPS1 audio-chip implementation.

Upstream: https://github.com/nukeykt/Nuked-OPM
Pinned source revision: f209e6ed3712032b641d53ce8fb24824eae6adc3 (2026-09-27). The vendored files are immutable repository inputs; update only with a deliberate source revision change.

The core is licensed under LGPL-2.1. See COPYING.LGPL-2.1 and the notices in opm.c/opm.h.

This component models the YM2151 peripheral only. It is not a CPU/game emulator and does not execute the Street Fighter II program.
